# The GitHub accounts whose issues triage may move to Ready on its own.
#
# One login per line; case doesn't matter, and `#` starts a comment. An open
# Backlog issue opened by anyone else gets the label `needs human` from
# board.yml, and triage leaves it alone until a maintainer either moves it
# themselves or adds the label `triage approved` to hand it to triage.
#
# board.yml reads this file from the branch it runs on, which is `main`, so an
# account is added by a pull request like any other change.
KyleBlankRollins
# The repository's own workflows, which open the nightly fuzz-crash issues and
# the docs report. Its login as the REST API gives it, `[bot]` included.
github-actions[bot]
